subtitle: A grocery list your AI sorts by aisle as you talk.
about: A note with grocery checklists grouped by aisle, from fruit and veg to household items. Tell your AI what you need, or add items yourself and tick them off as you shop.

ask.prompt: Set up the grocery list template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Add what you need
slides.you: We need apples, spinach, oat milk, salmon and bin bags.
slides.ai: Filed each one under its aisle.
slides.alt: Grocery list filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Add to an aisle
slides.you: Add rice, coffee and two cans of tomatoes.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: Grocery list as it starts, ready to fill in
